authorization: User explicitly selected exact current tree with LFS archives and a lossless original-history bundle. Original commit IDs are recoverable from bundle, not browsable as publication history.
native_git_history: Publication snapshot only. Original history in verified full bundle; no original commits rewritten.
inventory_exclusions: .git/** only; this contains local Git configuration/credentials and audit metadata, not distributable working files. Original branches/tags and reachable history are in the bundle.
original_package_policy_note: The complete working-tree inventory additionally includes all package ZIPs, generated Python caches, PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json and tests/package-integrity.json, which the existing package payload inventory excludes.
